column2: You get the feeling you're not alone here.
As you look around at the towering rocks, immense formations carved over millions of years, you can't help but be overwhelmed by a sense of your own insignificance.
You see a stairway of wind-eroded rock winding its way down to the water below.
Looking out across the expanse you see a natural bridge of rock.
I don't know what that is, but I see the need for a bunion pad or two. Maybe some pumice would help.

The hot sun and the butte's seductive curves are strangely exciting. You've reached the "plateau phase" which continues to the west, while the rocky layers climax in a makeshift staircase. In the distance, you can see the beautiful, tranquil Sea of Estros.
She looks like she might be familiar to you someday. However the gun in her hand looks like it could limit the chance of any lasting relationship in the future, or the past.
Hey! Would you like your chest cavity to host her spear?
The time for talk on your part appears to have passed. Speak now and forever hold your pieces.
You can bet she smells better than you. Better just speculate on this one or you'll be snorting spear.
Best to keep your tastbuds packed away right now, Buckwheat.
This one looks committed to finding out just how good you'd look on a spit.
Hey, are you trying to find out how you'd look with convenient ³handles protruding from each side of your less-than-studly self?
This would be an excellent time to keep your nostrils to yourself.
Gee! Maybe you should walk right on up to her and give it a try. NOT!!
Her speargun is pointed in a direction that eliminates any need for second thought.
Do it and die.
She looks completely uninterested in conversing with the likes of you.
Yeah! Right!
The submarine has a sporty look to it, distinctly hydrodynamic compared to those fine vessels you've travelled aboard recently.
This is not a good time for vessel-sniffing.
It's not a good time to slap the old buds on barnacles.
That hatch looks like the perfect place to have an entry/exit device.
Hmm...freshly lubricated.
Bubbles are churned out by the slow moving props.

Here at the base of the buttes lies the legendary Sea of Estros. The shimmering crystal-clear water is calm and inviting, giving no hint of the currents that could suck you under fast enough to pull your skin off and leave your insides standing on the shore. We could show you that, but it would be in bad taste.
The water here is quite deep.
This is Zondra. We are approaching checkpoint six. Prepare to open the tunnel door.
Activate the door.
You hope these women soon realize that they MUST have the wrong guy.
A spotlight illuminates the floor of the cave as the sub makes its way through the eerie darkness.
Say! There's an odd looking specimen.
You're not sure what it is, but you bet it would look cool spewing through the propellers.
An opening appears ahead.
The propellers thrust the small sub deeper and deeper into the dark tunnel.
This is a submarine.
I said that?
Was that me?
Hey! What are you doing?
Let me go b. . . witch!
Well,... now wait a minute. Let's talk about this.
You've got a lot of nerve coming back here, Roger Wilco.
After leaving me the way you did, you male Scum!
This is the last woman you'll ever dump on! Right, girls?!
Said ya couldn't be tied down...
You said ya had to be free to roam the galaxy.
You'll be sorrier than you look. We'll see to that!
Into the sub, fly boy.
Comfy, Mr. Wilco?
Shut up! Your whimpering sickens me!
I'll teach you not to run out on ME!
Thoreen is quite knowledgeable in the ways of torture.
I'll let you two get acquainted. Thoreen, do your stuff.
Wasn't he great, girls?
Well Rog...I guess we can call it even. Thank you for ridding our fortress of that slimy, awful, sea slug.
I..uh..I know I can't blame you for backing out at the last minute. I guess I was a little overbearing. Sorry. Can we still be good friends?
No Roger - you were right. You don't need to spare my feelings. It just wasn't meant to be. It's better this way.
Well girls, I feel like celebrating. LET'S GO SHOPPING!!!
RIGHT!
YEAH!
OUR HERO!!
Sit down!
With PLEASURE, Zondra.
Let me introduce you to a friend of mine.
This is the EpiRip 357, the most powerful hand hair remover in the universe and it's capable of shaving your legs clean off.
I've always wanted to see a man shave with one of these, but I guess you'll do.
Now you will know the meaning of the word PAIN.
AAAIIIIHHHH!!! It's a sea slug! Run, girls!
What have I stepped in this time you think to yourself as the Latex Babes' submarine makes its' way through the eerie blackness.
This is a sea cave.
This is the submarine in which the Latex Babes brought you here.
It looks like they have quite a fortress here.
There is a faint odor of perfume mixed with the salty sea air.
One of the many massive support pillars in the fortress.
It's a nifty entry/exit device.
Hmm. You wonder if she has a boyfriend.
You'd better not. She looks like she knows how to use that gun.
Talking isn't getting you anywhere with her.
Use it and lose it, buddy!
What a babe!
That isn't a good idea, she seems to hate you for some unknown reason.
Your efforts at conversation are rewarded with a hateful glare.
Boy! You don't know what you did to make her mad, but you sure hope you get a chance to smooth things over.
Compassion and warmth are not words which come to mind when looking at this person.
The guard looks on coldly.
You see what looks like highly pressurized oxygen tanks.
Yep, it's that nasty slug tongue again. Scary to think of what he can do with that thing, isn't it?
This isn't your garden variety slug.
Red eyes glare back at you.
You see what seems to be pressurized oxygen tanks.
This place is like a brick ship house.
How do I get into these situations?
ACME laser nodes, for all your torture needs.
It's a Mantrap restraint system.
It's a slimy slug tongue.
This switch activates a laser.
Desperately you try to push the button, but the restraints are just too tight!
Hot lights glare in your face making you very uncomfortable.
Shiny stainless steel instruments cover the surgical tray. Some of them look vaguely familiar as veterinary instruments.
Roger Wilco, space guy.
You are in a crude state-of-the-art sea cave.
It's the slug's intake orifice. Looks pretty disgusting, don't you think?
This slug has a very dexterous mouth.
Sea water and slug slime slowly ooze down the fin of this hideous creature.
It's slug slobber.
Staring contests were never your thing.
These things look like they have a life of their own.
Feels like being licked by a large dog with incredibly bad breath.
It looks like the internal pressure of the slug is starting to exceed its external strength.
Better take cover. It looks like slimey slug guts are gonna fly.
Meanwhile...back in Space Quest 12.
You give the window a sniff. However, no odor is detected.
Dragging your tongue along the window brings you to the realization that it hasn't been washed in a long, long time.
You speak in the direction of the glass but your syllables merely come careening back.
It's a flashing light.
You should know by now that you can't just take things without paying for them.
This store is closed. A security door blocks the entrance.
In the window, a robotic mannequin struts its stuff.
This is Sock's, a high-class, high-priced dress shoppe.
These steps lead down to the Skate-O-Rama.
It smells like something someone would walk on.
It tastes like something someone would walk on!
This is a fine example of the wonders of fabricated flora.
The fabricated flora has an equally artificial smell.
You know that eating plastic plants places pressure on your plumbing. You learned that reading JANITORIAL DIGEST.
They have a minty-fresh smell that keeps you refreshed.
Well, uh, this is kinda hard to explain...
Oooooh! Real plastic!
Yechh! Seriously gross!
Let's boogie, girls!
I sure know how to bust a move!
Nice walls!
Uh...we're right.
Um, I'm...uh...I'm not sure, but she's, um, built about like me.
I think I'll wear it home.
I would still like to buy that dress, I'm terribly sorry about the misunderstanding.
I'm not sure, I think I'll just look around for a bit.
AAAhh! The smell of brand new simulated fabric!
